9. Arrange the following compartments involved in the purification of water
in a proper order.
(A) Loading tank (B) Filtration tank
(C) Chlorination tank (D) Sedimentation tank
(a) BCDA (b) CDBA
(c) DABC (d) ADBC

10. Calculate the solubility of the salt A if 25 g of A is present in 225 g of the
saturated solution at a given temperature.
(a) 12 (b) 12.5 (c) 1.2 (d) 11.5

12. Efflorescent salts are the salts which __________.
(a) absorb water at room temperature
(b) release water at room temperature
(c) absorb water on heating
(d) release water on heating

13. Solubility of a gas in a liquid __________.
(a) increases with increase in temperature
(b) increases with increase in pressure
(c) does not alter with temperature
(d) does not alter with pressure

14. Identify the composition of water gas among the following.
(a) $\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$ (b) $\mathrm{CO} + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
(c) $\mathrm{CO} + \mathrm{H}_2$ (d) $\mathrm{CO}_2 + \mathrm{H}_2$
